title: Guarded pages that declare search metadata
why: A public page in a guarded folder was silently left out of sitemap.xml and llms.txt.
changelog: a page leaves sitemap.xml and llms.txt only for `robots` in its `<meta seo>`, no longer for the word noindex anywhere in the file

B0505 warns when `keyword` or `canonical` sits on a page its folder guard keeps out of search; a public page that redirects some visitors does it in `load()`; `brain add view` omits both under a guard
